UI_profdesc_DD_CultivationTech: Grew cannabis for a living. Knows every Grower's Handbook and Hydroponics Monthly recipe, spots plant sex, root rot and stress sooner, and roots cuttings 10 percent more often.
UI_profdesc_DD_Budtender: Worked the dispensary counter. Knows the rolling papers, curing jar and curing barrel recipes, reads everything about a bud at a glance, and cures buds up to +15 percent instead of +10 percent.
UI_profdesc_DD_Breeder: Bred plants for their genetics. Reads strain traits on any seed, cutting, plant or bud, spots hermie lines, gets one extra seed per pollination, and breeds truer, luckier crosses.
UI_trait_DD_CultivationTechDesc: Reads cannabis plants as if Agriculture were 2 levels higher, short of their genetics. Cuttings root 10 percent more often.
UI_trait_DD_BudtenderDesc: Inspect Bud shows everything at any Agriculture level. Buds you jar or burp cure up to +15 percent.
UI_trait_DD_BreederDesc: Reads strain traits and hermie lines at any Agriculture level. Pollinations you harvest give one extra seed; crosses vary less, and a big jump goes your way 3 times in 4.
UI_trait_DD_GreenThumbDesc: Cannabis you plant takes 15 percent less from care mistakes, and cuttings root 5 percent more often.
UI_trait_DD_TrimHandDesc: Trims plants twice as fast, and won't trim a plant that's still too wet to cure safely without asking first.
UI_trait_DD_ChronicDesc: Starts already dependent on cannabis with some tolerance. Withdrawal sets in about a day after the last smoke.
UI_trait_DD_LightweightDesc: Highs hit 50 percent harder and last longer, side effects included. Tolerance builds 50 percent faster.
